blocks.heading: Questions we hear a lot
blocks.intro: If yours isn’t here, email hello@example.com.

answer.p: The caracms package is free, under the MIT licence, with no caps. CaraCMS Cloud is optional: it takes on the annoying parts, such as GitHub access, images, and forms and email.

items.question: Which sites does it work with?

answer.p: Astro sites, on Astro 7 and Node 22.12 or later. npx caracms init adds it to a site you already have.
In the site’s own git repository, as JSON files. A Publish commits them to main, and the host deploys the change. See [editing](/services/websites) for more.
On any host that keeps one Node server running behind HTTPS: Railway, Render, Fly or a VPS.

items.question: Can a site use its own blocks?

answer.p: Yes. The **blocks** are the site’s own Astro components; caracms.config.ts lists them and their fields.
